title: Turn On the Immune System — Thymus + Bone Marrow ? B and T Cells

the_problem.before: the immune system is STATIC. it has 259K classified entities, VDJ recombination theory, antibody decay code, opsonize pipeline design — but nothing is RUNNING. it's a textbook immune system. it knows everything and does nothing.
specific: skunkBat runs locally (PID 1371) but NOT on golgi where traffic hits
thymus-bounce cron updates a timestamp, doesn't classify anything
bone marrow doesn't exist — no stem cell production at all
antibody confidence decaying 5%/day with ZERO stimulation
opsonize port 8095 DARK on golgi — tags exist but no tagger
swarmVine gossiping to 0 peers — immune memory not shared
259K entities classified in JSON, 0 acted on in real-time

bone_marrow.what: WHERE immune cells are BORN. the stem cell factory. in biology: spongy tissue inside bones. in us: the scan phase — generating raw entity observations from actual traffic.

produces.stem_cells: raw HTTP requests hitting Caddy ? parsed into observations
produces.how: caddy access log ? parse ? emit FleetObservation for each visit
produces.rate: every request IS a stem cell. no batch. continuous production.
produces.current_state: caddy access log exists but EMPTY (rotated to /dev/null or /var/log/caddy/). need to enable structured JSON logging.

activation_steps: 1. Enable Caddy JSON access logging to /var/log/caddy/access.json
2. Create bone-marrow.sh: tail -f access.json ? parse ? emit observations
3. Each observation = one stem cell entering the thymus for training

thymus.what: WHERE T cells MATURE. learns self from non-self. in biology: trains naive T cells using self-antigens. in us: the anderson-sort classifier that uses the identity-melt as its self-antigen library.
thymus.location: golgi + eastGate (dual thymus, like we have dual heads)

training.positive_selection: does this cell recognize self-antigens? if NO ? apoptosis (cell death). T cell MUST be able to see self before it can distinguish non-self.
training.negative_selection: does this cell ATTACK self-antigens? if YES ? apoptosis. autoimmune T cells are killed in the thymus, not in the bloodstream.
training.output: mature T cells that recognize self, ignore self, and attack non-self

T_cells.what: killers and helpers. they ACT directly.

CD8_cytotoxic.our_analog: HTTP 403 Forbidden response. the blackwall. the SHAN'T.
CD8_cytotoxic.action: request classified NON_SELF ? respond 403 + scatter fake data (skunkBat scatter.rs)
CD8_cytotoxic.trigger: immediate — any request matching NON_SELF pattern gets killed on contact

CD4_helper.role: COORDINATE immune response. tell other cells what to do.
CD4_helper.our_analog: ntfy nerve signal. when a threat is detected, the helper T cell fires a message to all organs.
CD4_helper.action: request classified NON_SELF ? fire ntfy alert ? skunkBat antibody insert ? swarmVine gossip to peers
CD4_helper.trigger: on first contact with new pattern — recruit help

T_reg.our_analog: rate limiting. the Willis balloon. if immune response rate exceeds threshold ? T_reg dampens.
T_reg.action: if >100 blocks/min ? ease off ? recheck ? prevent false positive cascade
T_reg.trigger: when CD8 kill rate exceeds threshold — autoimmune panic detection

B_cells.what: antibody factories. they MARK for later killing.

naive_B.our_analog: first-seen user-agent or IP pattern ? create new FleetAntibody in skunkBat store

plasma_B.role: activated B cell ? mass produce antibodies
plasma_B.our_analog: confirmed threat ? promote antibody confidence to 0.95, share via swarmVine gossip
plasma_B.action: 3+ defections from same pattern ? confidence 0.95 ? posture ACTIVE_DEFENSE ? gossip to peers

memory_B.our_analog: antibodies.json on disk. persists across restarts. the FOSSIL record of immunity.
memory_B.action: antibody with >10 encounters ? fossilize to disk ? never prune below 0.3 confidence

NK_cells.what: natural killer. innate immunity. no training needed.
NK_cells.our_analog: robots.txt + Caddy IP blocks + CF WAF rules. the INNATE immune system that works without learning.
NK_cells.action: hardcoded blocklists + rate limits. no classification needed. brute force defense.
NK_cells.note: this is the ONLY part of the immune system that's actually working right now

the_magistrate.role: the negentropy court. sits above the thymus.
the_magistrate.current: classifies but doesn't ACT. judge without a gavel.
the_magistrate.activation: the magistrate's GAVEL is the HTTP response code. 200=acquit, 403=guilty, 301=redirect-to-rehab, 204=no-content-for-null, 429=contempt-of-court (rate limited).
the_magistrate.integration: thymus classifies ? magistrate sentences ? T cell executes sentence ? B cell records precedent
the_magistrate.identity_melted_in: the magistrate's law book IS the identity-melt.json. self-antigens ARE the constitutional rights. if you match self-pattern, you have rights. if you don't, you face the court.
